outlook_desktop.title: Outlook desktop app
outlook_desktop.hint: The app on Windows or Mac

drop.title: Welcome. Drop in a document.
drop.lead: The last one you sent works great: nobody gets it during this test. In a minute, you'll watch it heat up the way your prospect will read it.
drop.coldPages: Your pages, still cold. They heat up every time your prospect reads them.
drop.nothingToInstall: Nothing to install to get started. It all happens here, in your browser.

test.title: Open it like your prospect
test.lead: Here's your test link. Open it as if you were your prospect, flip through a few pages, then come back here.
test.copied: Link copied. Open it on your phone.
test.notCounted: Nobody else gets it, and it doesn't count in your stats.
test.liveHint: That's what you'll see, live, when your prospect opens it. And Clozer will tell you when to follow up.
test.waiting: Waiting for you to read it…
test.linkFailed: The test link couldn't be created.
test.documentFailed: This document couldn't be read. Try another PDF.
test.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can go on without testing.

install.chromeLead: It works in {mailbox}, on Chrome or Edge. You attach a PDF as usual, it swaps it for a Clozer link and tells you when your prospect reads it.
install.chromeConnected: Extension connected. You can move on.
install.installFromStore: Install it from the Chrome Web Store.
install.openInChrome: Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer, then install it from the Chrome Web Store.
install.comingSoon: It's coming to the Chrome Web Store very soon. Until then, create your links in Clozer and paste them into your emails: we'll show you how right after.
install.pin: Pin it to the browser toolbar (puzzle icon), click Clozer, then “Connect Clozer”.
install.tryIt: Open {mailbox}, write an email and attach a PDF: Clozer swaps it for a link right away.
install.outlookLead: An add-in for Outlook on Windows or Mac. It swaps your attached PDFs for Clozer links and shows you who reads, without leaving Outlook.
install.outlookConnected: Outlook is connected. You can move on.
install.addFromFile: In Outlook: Add-ins › My add-ins › Add from file, then pick this file. In classic Outlook for Windows, it's under Home › Get Add-ins.
install.openEmail: Open a new email and click “Clozer” in the ribbon: a code shows up.
install.outlookDone: Attach a PDF to an email in Outlook: Clozer swaps it for a link right away.
install.itDeploy: Can't install add-ins? Your IT team can deploy it for the whole team from the Microsoft 365 admin center, with the same file.
install.manualLead: Clozer works with any email app: just paste the link instead of the attachment.
install.manual1: Drop your PDF into Clozer: the link to send is ready right away.
install.manual2: Paste it into your email instead of the attachment. Or click “Send by email”.
install.manual3: To test it, open it in a private window: your own reads don't count.
install.alsoUse: Also using Gmail or Outlook? <change>Change your answer</change>: Clozer can create the links for you.

mailStep.title: You write your emails in…
mailStep.leadWithName: {firstName}, Clozer can plug into your email: you attach the PDF as usual, it swaps it for a link.
mailStep.lead: Clozer can plug into your email: you attach the PDF as usual, it swaps it for a link.

mailToolTip.chrome: Next time, just attach the PDF in {mailbox}: the Chrome extension puts the link in its place for you.
mailToolTip.outlookAddin: Next time, just attach the PDF in Outlook: the Clozer add-in puts the link in its place for you.
mailToolTip.unknown: Sending from Gmail or Outlook? Just attach the PDF: Clozer can put the link in its place for you.

emailsPage.stopped: Got it, you won't get these tips anymore.
emailsPage.body: These few emails help you get started. Your alerts and morning report don't change.

firstSteps.title: First steps
firstSteps.dropBody: A quote, an invoice, a deck or a technical doc as a PDF, or a Notion, Loom, Figma link… The link to send is ready right away.
firstSteps.sendManyBody: They're ready, under “To send” just below. Paste each one into your email instead of the attachment: your prospect reads without filling anything in.
firstSteps.sendOneBody: It's ready, under “To send” just below. Paste it into your email instead of the attachment: your prospect reads without filling anything in.
firstSteps.sendBody: Paste it into your email instead of the attachment. One link per prospect: you'll know who reads.
firstSteps.readBody: You get notified, and you see here which pages they read and when to follow up. To test it, open it in a private window: your own reads don't count.

welcomeMessage.linkVersion: Version for this prospect, replacing the document's

extensionBanner.updating: Updating now. Reload Gmail or Outlook in a few seconds.
extensionBanner.updateNotYet: The update hasn't reached Chrome yet. Try again in a few minutes.
extensionBanner.reloadAfterInstall: Once the extension is added to Chrome, reload this page.
extensionBanner.absent: Attach the PDF in Gmail or Outlook, and the Chrome extension swaps in the Clozer link. You'll know when the prospect reads it.
extensionBanner.outdated: A new version of the Clozer extension is ready.
extensionBanner.otherAccount: The extension is connected to {extensionEmail}, not {userEmail}.
extensionBanner.signedOut: The Clozer extension is installed. Just connect it to your account.

daily.title: Now, for real.
daily.lead: Day to day, you sell like you always have. Clozer does the tracking.
daily.sendTitle: You send the link to your prospect
daily.sendBody: Copy your document's link and paste it into your email instead of the attachment. Or click “Send by email”: the message is already written.
daily.alertTitle: You get notified when they read
daily.alertBody: By email, and live on your dashboard. That's the right time to call.
daily.approveBody: Clozer writes them, you approve. They go out with your address as reply-to: the prospect answers you.
daily.hintManual: Perfect: pasting the link into your email is all it takes.
daily.hintConnected: Your email is already connected to Clozer.
daily.hintSoon: Soon, Clozer will put the link in your emails for you. Until then, copy-paste does the job.
daily.hintInstall: Clozer can put the link in your emails for you. <link>Set it up in 2 minutes</link>. Nothing required: copy-paste works too.
daily.extensionBody: The Clozer extension swaps it for a link and tells you when your prospect reads it. Without it, copy-pasting the link works too.
daily.thenConnect: Then connect it, step by step
daily.desktopOnly: It installs from Chrome or Edge on a computer. Open Clozer there when you want to add it.
daily.offerSaveFailed: Couldn't save. You can do it in Settings.
daily.offerSaved: Offer saved. You can add to it in Settings.
daily.offerPlaceholder: E.g. scheduling software for architecture firms, $200 to $800 a month.
daily.offerHint: Clozer uses it to write your follow-ups. Left empty, it works out your offer from your first document.
